changelog: A big content + polish drop. Risk events got a major rework: the Hexed Standard now curses EVERY choice, you can choose to FIGHT the Rival Warlord (a real elite battle), the Doctrine Relic lets you forge a medal of your choosing, and there are fresh trades in Devil's Bargain and the Bone Reliquary. Two new cursed medals join the pool — Necrosis (your units can't be healed) and Broken Chevrons (your units can't gain rank). Sapper Charge can now be dropped on ANY visible tile, not just an enemy, and reliably disables units standing on crates, nodes and other objective tiles. Reinforced Plating is now an Order card, not a structure. Battle UI: the medal bar is a clean transparent overlay that hides when you hold no medals, and the camera no longer snaps back to a unit after you move it. Under the hood, a major rendering pass fixes the horizontal tearing and glitches on large, fully-revealed maps (viewport tile culling + a composited board), and the wood table now always frames the board.
